title: Renewal pipeline scenario slate — Oct 2026
content:
HEADER: Renewal pipeline scenario grid (operational view)

Columns: Account | ARR | Contract End | Renewal Owner | Probability (%) | Next Step (owner + due) | Last Contacted | Risk Notes | Playbook Tier | Escalation Path

Rows:
BeaconPay | $420,000 | 2026-11-21 | Ravi Kumar | 85 | Executive business review scheduled (Ravi - 2026-10-20) | 2026-10-03 | Low risk; usage steady; finance approval pending for 2% uplift | Tier A - standard QBR + exec expansion ask | If finance stalls -> AE escalation to CRO
AeroHealth | $1,120,000 | 2026-12-05 | Sofia Alvarez | 45 | Product regression investigation (Sofia - 2026-10-14) | 2026-09-28 | Medium risk; recent latency regressions on private deployment; legal wants updated DPA | Tier B - technical remediation + legal review | SRE + Legal co-owners, escalate to VP CS if unresolved by 10/28
DataMuse | $75,000 | 2026-11-09 | Ben Cho | 60 | Renewal pricing options email (Ben - 2026-10-12) | 2026-09-30 | Small account; showing churn signals (drop in seat add-ons) | Tier C - light touch, automated renewal + PO reminders | Standard auto-collection flow
NimbusRetail | $2,400,000 | 2027-01-17 | Claire Morgan | 92 | Finalize committed burst capacity contract (Claire - 2026-10-22) | 2026-10-01 | Strategic customer; wants dedicated capacity SLA | Tier A - enterprise playbook + exec alignment | Legal + Sales to sign term sheet by 11/05
Quantify.ai | $310,000 | 2026-10-30 | Ravi Kumar | 30 | Internal health check + pricing concession request (Ravi - 2026-10-08) | 2026-09-20 | High risk; alternative vendor PoC underway; reported 12% cost delta | Tier B - concession matrix applicable; present Optimize report | If probability drops to <20% trigger AE retention bridge
MercuryBank | $980,000 | 2026-12-11 | Sofia Alvarez | 78 | Security attestation deliverable (Sofia - 2026-10-15) | 2026-10-04 | Regulatory customer; waiting on pen-test report; low tolerance for infra incidents | Tier A - compliance track + renewal buffer | Escalate to Security Director if pen-test delayed beyond 10/25
AtlasInsights | $55,000 | 2026-11-02 | Ben Cho | 50 | Feature prioritization sync (Ben - 2026-10-18) | 2026-09-29 | Moderate; requesting embeddings customization which impacts roadmap | Tier C - product-ask playbook; propose phased roadmap | Product + Solutions to propose POC by 10/28
BlueRidge Labs | $185,000 | 2026-12-03 | Claire Morgan | 68 | Contract amendment draft (Claire - 2026-10-19) | 2026-10-02 | Negotiation on term length; potential to upsell research add-on | Tier B - negotiation + upsell playbook | Finance approval for 10% discount cap required

ASSUMPTIONS AND MODEL NOTES:
- Probability column is a blend of historical renewal rate by tier, recent engagement signals (last contact, product health), and manual owner judgement.
- Tier definitions: Tier A = strategic / >$500k or high strategic value; Tier B = mid-market $100k-$500k; Tier C = self-serve / <$100k.
- Dates use customer local timezone; next steps assume owners will update 'Last Contacted' after outreach.

SCENARIOS SIMULATOR (short):
- Base case: apply Probability as-is to ARR to estimate forecasted renewal ARR for rolling 90-day pipeline. Example: Forecasted ARR = sum(ARR * Probability).
- Upside: +10% to Probability if exec sponsor confirmed in next 14 days.
- Downside: -25% to Probability if POC competitor receives active signoff or if critical incident within 30 days.

QUICK METRICS (snapshot):
- Total ARR in sheet: $5,545,000
- Weighted renewal forecast (base): $3,465,600 (calculated manually from rows above)
- High-priority at-risk ARR (Probability <= 50%): Quantify.ai ($310k) + AtlasInsights ($55k) + DataMuse ($75k) = $440,000

OPEN ACTIONS / OWNER CHECKLIST (next 14 days):
- Ravi: follow up BeaconPay exec invite + Quantify.ai health check (due 10/12, 10/08)
- Sofia: expedite pen-test confirmation for MercuryBank and confirm DPA updates for AeroHealth (due 10/15, 10/14)
- Ben: send pricing options to DataMuse and schedule AtlasInsights POC scoping (due 10/12, 10/18)
- Claire: finalize NimbusRetail committed capacity term sheet and draft BlueRidge amendment (due 10/22, 10/19)

NOTES FOR QBR / HANDOFF TO SALES:
- Flag NimbusRetail and MercuryBank for exec-level QBR slides (include token-level cost breakdown and SLA commitments).
- Prepare Optimize-run report for Quantify.ai to show cost savings vs competitors; include quantized model recommendations.
- Legal: prepare DPA and SOC attestation templates to attach to renewals with >$250k ARR.

CHANGE LOG (draft):
- 2026-10-05: initial scenario slate created (Claire)
- 2026-10-08: Quantify.ai probability re-assessed after competitor PoC update (Ravi)
- 2026-10-12: weights adjusted for BeaconPay after exec alignment (Ravi)

ENDPOINT: This sheet is a working scenario generator for weekly renewal standups. Update rows in-line and preserve 'Last Contacted' after outreach. Use the "Up/Down" scenario rules when prepping QBR talking points.
